items.title: 15.7 Effects of drugs on nervous coordination (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of drugs and their effects (PDF 46-47).

blocks.text: Drug (dawa) khurak ke ilawa koi bhi madda hai jo kisi bimari ya ghair maamooli halat ki rok thaam, tashkhees, ilaj ya alamaat mein kami ke liye istemal ho. Dawayein dimagh par asar kar ke mizaj, hosh, khayalat, jazbat ya rawayya bhi badal sakti hain.

items: Psychoactive drug: aisi dawa jo dimagh ka kaam badal kar mizaj, idraak, hosh aur rawayya badle, maslan alcohol, caffeine, nicotine aur ghair qanooni drugs jaise cocaine aur heroin.
Narcotic: dard kam karne wali opioid dawa jis mein lat (addiction) aur ghalat istemal ka bara imkan ho, jaise morphine, codeine aur oxycodone.

blocks.title: Narcotics aur psychoactive drugs
blocks.text: Tamam narcotics psychoactive drugs hain, magar tamam psychoactive drugs narcotics nahi.

blocks.prompt: Kya caffeine narcotic hai? Wazahat kijiye.
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Caffeine psychoactive hai (chaukasi badalti hai) magar opioid dard-kush dawa nahi, is liye narcotic nahi.

items: Drug: ghair khurak madda rok thaam, tashkhees, ilaj ya aaraam ke liye. Psychoactive drugs dimagh ka kaam badalti; narcotics lat wali opioid dard-kush dawayein.
